summary: Use the JS function-object runtime when an ordinary function's prototype property is read, written, or otherwise observed.

target.notes: Ordinary constructable functions have a mutable own prototype data property whose default object contains constructor. C# delegate/type metadata is not equivalent.

semantics.default_value: object with constructor property referring back to function

caveats: Arrow/method/async functions differ in constructability and may lack prototype.
Changing prototype affects future new operations but not existing instance prototype chains.
references: ECMAScript 2026 Language Specification Function Instances prototype

tests.name: replacing prototype
tests.input: function C(){}; const p={y:4}; C.prototype=p; console.log(Object.getPrototypeOf(new C())===p);
